Description: Women become exposed through bites from infectious mosquitoes or sexual contact with infectious men.
A fraction of exposed women progress to symptomatic infectious women after the latent period.
The remaining exposed women progress to asymptomatically infectious women after the latent period.
Symptomatic women transition to the post-viremia infectious stage after blood clearance.
Asymptomatic women transition to the post-viremia infectious stage after blood clearance.
Women recover after the period of viral persistence in vaginal fluids.
Men become exposed through bites from infectious mosquitoes or sexual contact with infectious women.
A fraction of exposed men progress to symptomatic infectious men after the latent period.
The remaining exposed men progress to asymptomatically infectious men after the latent period.
Symptomatic men transition to the post-viremia infectious stage after blood clearance.
Asymptomatic men transition to the post-viremia infectious stage after blood clearance.
Men recover after the period of viral persistence in semen.
Mosquitoes become exposed by biting infectious humans.
Exposed mosquitoes become infectious after the extrinsic latent period.

Name: βvh
Description: Mosquito-to-human transmission rate.

Name: βhv
Description: Human-to-mosquito transmission rate.

Name: βwm
Description: Women-to-men transmission rate.

Name: βmw
Description: Men-to-women transmission rate.

Name: ϕ
Description: Proportion of symptomatic infections.

Name: 1/λh
Description: Intrinsic latent period in humans.

Name: 1/λv
Description: Extrinsic latent period in mosquitoes.

Name: 1/γ1
Description: Mean time to viral clearance from blood.

Name: 1/γ2
Description: Mean time to viral clearance from semen.

Name: 1/γ3
Description: Mean time to viral clearance from vaginal fluids.

Name: 1/ν
Description: Mosquito life span.

Name: λh
Description: Intrinsic latent rate used as a constant in fitting.

Name: λv
Description: Extrinsic latent rate used as a constant in fitting.

Name: ν
Description: Assumed constant mosquito life span used in fitting.

Name: γ1
Description: Blood clearance rate parameter, inverse of mean clearance time.

Name: γ2
Description: Inverse of mean time to viral clearance from semen; table reports fitted values by municipality.

Name: γ3
Description: Inverse of mean time to viral clearance from vaginal fluids; table reports fitted values by municipality.
